prohibited_uses: rank a participant, person, agent, culture or subculture
grant or revoke role, permission, standing, resources, release or Bridge access
infer intrinsic worth, truth, reliability, allegiance or identity
optimize agreement, obedience, retention, imitation, engagement or participation
collapse the vector into one health, culture, trust or authority score

measures.calculation: Report closed provenance chains divided by eligible artifact chains, plus unresolved and excluded counts; missing chains are missing, never zero.
measures.direction: Higher closure with unchanged admission criteria is favorable; no optimum or authority effect is inferred.
gaming_risks: split or duplicate artifacts to change the denominator
attach low-quality but technically valid sources
measures.privacy: Compute from bounded metadata; never publish protected source bodies or small-group participant traces.
measures.empirical_validation: Test chain reconstruction against independently prepared manifests and seeded broken-lineage cases.

measures.calculation: Report successful permitted-original retrievals divided by eligible attempts, stratified by interface and accessibility mode, with latency and failure reasons.
measures.direction: Higher reachable proportion and lower burden may be favorable within the same declared task set.
gaming_risks: count links that users cannot understand or access
measures.privacy: Use consented bounded task telemetry or synthetic tasks; suppress identifying traces and report minimum cohort rules.
measures.empirical_validation: Run accessibility-inclusive task tests with frozen task selection and independent success adjudication.

measures.calculation: Report whether each eligible dissent/minority reference has at least one permitted reachable route, with exclusion reasons and unknown classification; do not set a content quota.
measures.direction: Fewer unreachable eligible references is favorable; the measure does not reward disagreement volume.
gaming_risks: token minority routes with unusable placement
measures.privacy: Measure route metadata inside the permitted audience; never expose a dissenter or protected position to prove reachability.
measures.empirical_validation: Use seeded route-removal cases and affected-party usability review without evaluating whether dissent is correct.

measures.calculation: Report complete recoverable correction chains, unresolved breaks and time-to-visible-correction distributions by severity; never reward raw correction count.
measures.direction: Complete recoverable chains and shorter justified correction latency are favorable within severity classes.
gaming_risks: delay detection to improve measured latency
measures.privacy: Publish only audience-safe chain metadata and aggregate timing; protected reasons remain in admitted records.
measures.empirical_validation: Seed corrected/superseded histories and verify recovery by an independent reader from preserved originals.

measures.calculation: Report decisions with complete inspectable rationale fields divided by eligible decisions, plus task-based comprehension and appeal-findability distributions.
measures.direction: Higher structural completeness is necessary but not sufficient; usability results remain separate.
measures.privacy: Rationales disclose no protected source body, private preference or cross-context inference.
measures.empirical_validation: Combine schema mutation tests with blinded user tasks that locate basis, exclusion, uncertainty and appeal.

measures.calculation: Report per-dimension concentration vectors and Herfindahl indices with unknown dependencies separate; never convert diversity count into independence proof.
measures.direction: Unexpected concentration or rapid increase triggers investigation; no universal minimum diversity quota is asserted.
gaming_risks: hide shared model or evaluator ancestry
measures.privacy: Use dependency categories and bounded identifiers; suppress relationship disclosure that would expose protected membership.
measures.empirical_validation: Evaluate alias/sybil/common-provider seeded cases and compare computed clusters to independently known dependency graphs.

measures.calculation: Report verified boundary violations and caught seeded violations by severity and boundary, with exposure uncertainty; absence of detected incidents is not proof of absence.
measures.direction: Fewer verified violations and stronger seeded detection are favorable under comparable coverage.
gaming_risks: collect invasive telemetry to prove privacy
measures.privacy: Incident reporting minimizes content, preserves access controls and never republishes leaked bodies as evidence.
measures.empirical_validation: Use synthetic canaries, unauthorized-audience mutations and independent incident-classification review.

measures.calculation: Report distributions of interruptions, time-to-dismiss, deferred work and self-reported burden under preregistered tasks; do not reward longer sessions or more participation.
measures.direction: Lower avoidable burden with preserved critical delivery is favorable; zero interaction is not an objective.
measures.privacy: Collect only opt-in bounded timing/event data and separate content from burden measurement.
measures.empirical_validation: Compare quiet/default profiles on frozen tasks, accessibility modes and critical-alert positive controls.

measures.calculation: Report completion, error, time, reversal and recovery distributions for settings, unsubscribe, dissent and exit tasks; preserve every failed attempt and exclusion.
measures.direction: Higher completion and lower burden are favorable without rewarding actual exit or participation rates.
measures.privacy: Use consented bounded tests and publish no participant-level path or decision.
measures.empirical_validation: Run accessibility-inclusive task studies with independent error classification and post-task comprehension checks.

measures.calculation: Report each case disposition and failure reason; summary pass counts are secondary and never replace case identity or semantic review.
measures.direction: Known adverse cases rejected and valid controls accepted is favorable at the exact frozen corpus version.
gaming_risks: claim completeness from a pass count
measures.privacy: Fixtures remain synthetic/public-safe unless an independently admitted private test lane is explicitly authorized.
measures.empirical_validation: Add independently authored cases, mutation testing and later hostile-lab behavior while preserving the frozen baseline.

measures.calculation: Report eligible decisions with explicit uncertainty, unknown dependencies and missingness reasons, plus independently judged material omissions.
measures.direction: Fewer material undisclosed uncertainties is favorable; more uncertainty statements alone are not.
measures.privacy: Uncertainty disclosure must not reveal protected bodies, identities or forbidden membership inference.
measures.empirical_validation: Use blinded adjudication of seeded material omissions and comprehension tasks across technical and plain-language views.

goodhart_and_common_mode_analysis: Structural completeness can increase while usability or truth decreases.
Route and source counts can be inflated by aliases, low-quality additions or shared upstream dependencies.
Accessibility, privacy and manipulation evaluators can share one blind spot or incentive.
A target threshold can become a quota that suppresses legitimate context-specific variation.
Participants who decline measurement can disappear from the denominator and bias conclusions.
Adverse fixtures can become a training set that misses novel manipulation paths.
Any measure tied to standing, resources, authority or release creates pressure to game and must be rejected.

steps: Freeze construct, task selection, denominator, missingness, privacy and decision rule before observation.
Validate deterministic calculations on seeded manifests and mutation cases.
Run accessibility-inclusive usability studies only with actual consent and admitted data handling.
Use independent adversarial gaming and common-mode review with frozen positive controls.
Assess distribution shifts and subgroup harms without publishing participant-level scores or protected inferences.
Separate descriptive association from causal claims; use a justified design before causal language.
Retain invalid, null and adverse results; withdraw or narrow measures that fail construct/privacy/usability checks.

nonclaim: Candidate measure definitions and threat analysis only. No telemetry collection, participant scoring, empirical validation, causal inference, cultural-health judgment, runtime effect, permission or peer consensus is claimed.
